name: Obsidian Export
description: Auto-saves every OpenClaw session transcript to an Obsidian vault with no LLM tokens, plus an on-demand agent-authored summary export.

outputDir.description: Absolute (or ~/) directory where session notes are written. Defaults to $OBSIDIAN_VAULT_PATH/_Shared_Systems/Openclaw or ~/Brain/_Shared_Systems/Openclaw.

userName.description: Label for user messages in the transcript (default: You).

assistantName.description: Label for assistant messages in the transcript (default: Assistant).

sessionPrefix.description: Prefix for the transcript heading (default: Session).

transcriptFilenameFormat.description: Filename template for auto transcripts. Tokens: {date} {hostname} {title} {sessionId}. Default: '{hostname} - {title} - Transcript'.

summaryFilenameFormat.description: Filename template for on-demand summaries. Tokens: {date} {hostname} {title} {sessionId}. Default: '{hostname} - {title} - Summary'.
